<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="420" viewBox="0 0 1200 420" role="img" aria-label="Anurag Raghav Sinha, full-stack developer" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="card"><rect width="1200" height="420" rx="22"/></clipPath>
    <pattern id="dots" width="22" height="22" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1.2" fill="#1BA3B5" fill-opacity=".10"/>
    </pattern>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx=".5" cy=".5" r=".5">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1BA3B5" stop-opacity=".30"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1BA3B5" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <clipPath id="tens"><rect x="1034" y="136" width="12" height="22"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="ones"><rect x="1046" y="136" width="12" height="22"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .sans { font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; }
    .mono { font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; }
    .role { opacity: 0; animation: role 9s infinite both; }
    .r2 { animation-delay: 3s; } .r3 { animation-delay: 6s; }
    @keyframes role {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      4% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
      30% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
      34% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px); }
    }
    .chip-p { animation: chipP 6s infinite both; }
    .chip-a { opacity: 0; animation: chipA 6s infinite both; }
    @keyframes chipP { 0%,45% { opacity: 1; } 50%,95% { opacity: 0; } 100% { opacity: 1; } }
    @keyframes chipA { 0%,45% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.9); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.06); } 54%,95% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
    .chip-a { transform-origin: 1083px 344px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .role, .chip-p, .chip-a { animation: none; }
      .r1 { opacity: 1; }
    }
  </style>

  <g clip-path="url(#card)">
    <rect width="1200" height="420" fill="#0B1F24"/>
    <rect width="1200" height="420" fill="url(#dots)"/>
    <circle cx="905" cy="230" r="330" fill="url(#glow)"/>

    <!-- left: name and roles -->
    <text x="72" y="98" class="sans" font-size="22" fill="#8FA3A8">Hi, I'm</text>
    <text x="68" y="172" class="sans" font-size="78" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="-2" fill="#E8F1F2">Anurag</text>
    <text x="68" y="248" class="sans" font-size="78" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="-2" fill="#E8F1F2">Raghav Sinha</text>

    <g class="sans" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#1BA3B5">
      <text x="72" y="298" class="role r1">Full-stack developer</text>
      <text x="72" y="298" class="role r2">I build backends businesses run on</text>
      <text x="72" y="298" class="role r3">CRMs, helpdesks and SLA engines</text>
    </g>

    <text x="72" y="346" class="sans" font-size="18" fill="#8FA3A8">Node.js, React and MongoDB, in production.</text>
    <text x="72" y="374" class="sans" font-size="18" fill="#8FA3A8">Greater Noida, India. Open to remote.</text>

    <!-- right: helpdesk / CRM window -->
    <rect x="640" y="46" width="530" height="400" rx="16" fill="#0D262C" stroke="#1E4148" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M640 62 a16 16 0 0 1 16 -16 h498 a16 16 0 0 1 16 16 v14 h-530 z" fill="#0F2E35"/>
    <circle cx="664" cy="61" r="5" fill="#FF7A59"/><circle cx="681" cy="61" r="5" fill="#F2B544"/><circle cx="698" cy="61" r="5" fill="#5EE6C7"/>
    <text x="905" y="65" class="mono" font-size="12" fill="#8FA3A8" text-anchor="middle">helpdesk / tickets</text>

    <!-- ticket with live SLA countdown -->
    <rect x="664" y="92" width="482" height="96" rx="12" fill="#10292F" stroke="#1E4148"/>
    <text x="684" y="121" class="mono" font-size="13" fill="#8FA3A8">#351</text>
    <rect x="726" y="107" width="96" height="19" rx="9.5" fill="#FF7A59" fill-opacity=".16"/>
    <text x="774" y="121" class="sans" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#FF7A59" text-anchor="middle">High priority</text>
    <text x="684" y="150" class="sans" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#E8F1F2">Projector not turning on</text>
    <text x="684" y="174" class="sans" font-size="13" fill="#8FA3A8">Room B-204, raised by faculty</text>

    <text x="1056" y="127" class="sans" font-size="11" fill="#8FA3A8" text-anchor="end">Resolve in</text>
    <g class="mono" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#E8F1F2" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="982" y="153">0</text><text x="993" y="153">1</text><text x="1002" y="151">:</text>
      <text x="1011" y="153">4</text><text x="1022" y="153">2</text><text x="1031" y="151">:</text>
      <g clip-path="url(#tens)">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" calcMode="discrete" dur="60s" repeatCount="indefinite"
            values="0 0;0 -22;0 -44;0 -66;0 -88;0 -110"/>
          <text x="1040" y="153">5</text><text x="1040" y="175">4</text><text x="1040" y="197">3</text>
          <text x="1040" y="219">2</text><text x="1040" y="241">1</text><text x="1040" y="263">0</text>
        </g>
      </g>
      <g clip-path="url(#ones)">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" calcMode="discrete" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"
            values="0 0;0 -22;0 -44;0 -66;0 -88;0 -110;0 -132;0 -154;0 -176;0 -198"/>
          <text x="1052" y="153">9</text><text x="1052" y="175">8</text><text x="1052" y="197">7</text>
          <text x="1052" y="219">6</text><text x="1052" y="241">5</text><text x="1052" y="263">4</text>
          <text x="1052" y="285">3</text><text x="1052" y="307">2</text><text x="1052" y="329">1</text>
          <text x="1052" y="351">0</text>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
    <circle cx="1100" cy="140" r="28" fill="none" stroke="#1E4148" stroke-width="6"/>
    <circle cx="1100" cy="140" r="28" fill="none" stroke="#1BA3B5" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-dasharray="176" stroke-dashoffset="0" transform="rotate(-90 1100 140)">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="0;150" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="stroke" values="#1BA3B5;#1BA3B5;#FF7A59" keyTimes="0;.65;1" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <text x="1100" y="144" class="sans" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#E8F1F2" text-anchor="middle">SLA</text>

    <!-- escalation chain -->
    <text x="684" y="222" class="sans" font-size="12" fill="#8FA3A8">Escalation chain, checked every 5 minutes</text>
    <line x1="700" y1="252" x2="880" y2="252" stroke="#1BA3B5" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="880" y1="252" x2="1060" y2="252" stroke="#1E4148" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="880" y1="252" x2="880" y2="252" stroke="#FF7A59" stroke-width="3">
      <animate attributeName="x2" values="880;1060;1060;880" keyTimes="0;.35;.92;1" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
    <circle cx="700" cy="252" r="8" fill="#1BA3B5"/>
    <circle cx="880" cy="252" r="8" fill="#1BA3B5"/>
    <circle cx="1060" cy="252" r="8" fill="#1E4148">
      <animate attributeName="fill" values="#1E4148;#1E4148;#FF7A59;#FF7A59;#1E4148" keyTimes="0;.34;.36;.92;1" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="1060" cy="252" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FF7A59" stroke-width="2" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="8;8;20;20" keyTimes="0;.36;.5;1" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0;.8;0;0" keyTimes="0;.35;.36;.5;1" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <g class="sans" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="700" y="282" fill="#E8F1F2">Raised</text>
      <text x="880" y="282" fill="#E8F1F2">Assigned to L1</text>
      <text x="1060" y="282" fill="#E8F1F2">Escalated to L2</text>
    </g>
    <g class="mono" font-size="11" fill="#8FA3A8" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="700" y="298">09:05</text><text x="880" y="298">09:07</text><text x="1060" y="298">11:07</text>
    </g>

    <!-- quotation with approval flip -->
    <rect x="664" y="318" width="482" height="96" rx="12" fill="#10292F" stroke="#1E4148"/>
    <text x="684" y="347" class="sans" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#E8F1F2">Quotation Q-1047</text>
    <text x="684" y="370" class="sans" font-size="12" fill="#8FA3A8">3 vendors compared, GST and freight included</text>
    <text x="684" y="400" class="mono" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#E8F1F2">₹4,82,600</text>
    <text x="1126" y="400" class="sans" font-size="11" fill="#8FA3A8" text-anchor="end">Totals checked on the server</text>
    <g class="chip-p">
      <rect x="1040" y="332" width="86" height="24" rx="12" fill="#F2B544" fill-opacity=".16"/>
      <text x="1083" y="348" class="sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#F2B544" text-anchor="middle">Pending</text>
    </g>
    <g class="chip-a">
      <rect x="1040" y="332" width="86" height="24" rx="12" fill="#5EE6C7" fill-opacity=".18"/>
      <text x="1083" y="348" class="sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5EE6C7" text-anchor="middle">Approved</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
